remarks: Fully Renovated Single-Family Rental on Quiet Norwalk Street.  Welcome to your next home-completely renovated and move-in ready. This charming single-family house offers 3 spacious bedrooms and 1 beautifully updated bathroom, all on a peaceful street in Norwalk. With 1,358 square feet of living space, it's the perfect mix of modern updates and everyday comfort.  Step into a brand-new kitchen with stainless steel appliances, sleek cabinetry, and fresh finishes throughout. The bathroom has been fully remodeled with a clean, contemporary look. Gleaming, refinished hardwood floors run throughout the home, and every room has been freshly painted.  Enjoy plenty of yard space, a small back deck for relaxing or entertaining, and ample parking. Laundry is located in the basement, and the home is available for immediate occupancy. No pets allowed. Utilities are tenant's responsibility.
